quality.title: Title
quality.title.explanation: Identifies the deposit and makes it discoverable.
quality.authors.explanation: Attributes the work to the people who produced the data.
quality.version.explanation: Identifies the exact content being reused or cited.
quality.institution.explanation: Identifies the organisation responsible for the deposit.
quality.methodology.explanation: Allows evaluation of how data were produced and processed.
quality.description.explanation: Provides readable documentation for interpreting the content.
quality.files.explanation: Provides deposit content, not just metadata.
quality.doi.explanation: Provides a persistent identifier for citing the published version.
quality.orcid.explanation: Distinguishes authors; a declared ORCID is not proof of identity.
quality.ror.explanation: Distinguishes institutions using a persistent identifier.
quality.summary.explanation: Describes the contents of the data and how they can be reused.
quality.coverage.explanation: Defines the time and place represented by the data; may not apply.
quality.profileExplanation: This field is required by the saved rules of the applied profile; changing the administrative profile does not change this deposit.
catalog.definition.publishedVersions: Existing versions with PUBLISHED status; each version is counted once. Excludes drafts and withdrawn versions.
catalog.definition.openPolicyVersions: Published versions with a declared OPEN policy. Does not establish actual download availability or embargo compliance.
catalog.definition.publishedCollections: Collections marked as public, including those with no visible versions.
operations.title: Datos RedUniv · Operations
operations.heading: Operational status
operations.lead: Storage and integrity with explicit measurement dates and scope.
operations.inventoryNote: Results are recorded states, not a new verification. The technical inventory may include drafts and references awaiting cleanup.
operations.auditNote: Up to twenty recent audits. The absence of audits does not mean files have been verified.

operations.scope: The configured local storage volume; includes space used by other services. Does not represent a quota or dataset size.
operations.noAudits: No audits have been recorded yet.

wizard.heading: Create dataset
wizard.lead: Complete the steps and check the preview before saving or submitting for review.
wizard.autosaveInitial: Your metadata are automatically saved in this browser; select files again if you reload the page.
wizard.title: Title
wizard.authorIdentifiersNote: After saving the draft, you can assign ORCID and institution/ROR to each author separately.
wizard.orcidNote: Optional; exported to DataCite only when there is one author
wizard.summaryNote: What the deposit contains and how it can be reused; does not replace the methodology.
wizard.translationsNote: Declared translations of title and abstract. Does not change the interface language or automatically translate files.
wizard.geoNote: Place or region represented; do not publish sensitive locations.
wizard.provenanceNote: Document how data were produced and processed. Do not include personal data, secrets or private server paths. This does not represent an execution verified by the platform.
wizard.productionPlaceholder: Sources, instruments, collection or simulation, and selection criteria
wizard.processingPlaceholder: Cleaning, transformations, exclusions and steps to reproduce the result
wizard.toolsPlaceholder: Software, versions, parameters or links to public scripts
wizard.package: A single ZIP of the complete deposit
wizard.descriptionNote: A file named exactly description.md, or a ZIP with description.md at its root and supporting images
wizard.zipNote: Must contain description/description.md; put images inside description/ and dataset files at the ZIP root.
wizard.markdownImagesBefore: In the Markdown, reference images using relative paths such as
wizard.markdownImagesAfter: . The presence of at least one file of the selected type will be validated.
wizard.sensitiveQuestion: Does it contain personal or confidential data?
wizard.protectionNote: Do not enter personal data or secrets here. If the information is sensitive, select restricted access and explain anonymisation, consent or access conditions. This note is neither autosaved in the browser nor published.
wizard.doiUrls: DOI or URL, one per line
wizard.fundingNote: Optional. The funder, ROR and project will be shown in the record and DOI metadata.
wizard.preflightNote: This preflight checks metadata and local selections. No files have been sent. The server will validate permissions, types and ZIP content when saving; this result does not grant curation approval.
wizard.previewNote: Preview of the draft before transfer. ZIPs also require reviewing the extracted files and description in the saved record before submission for curation.
wizard.confirmNote: Saving a draft does not publish the dataset. Submitting for review starts curation; only an authorised role can approve and publish after server checks.
wizard.acknowledge: I have reviewed the record, provisional citation and selected files.
wizard.partialWarning: If an upload fails, the draft will be kept for correction and will not be partially submitted. If ZIPs are included, the draft will be saved first so you can review its actual content before submitting.

vocabulary.heading: Deposit vocabularies
vocabulary.lead: Propose a list and approve it explicitly. Draft lists do not change active suggestions.
vocabulary.disclaimer: Approval records a local administrative decision; it does not certify external institutional approval. It does not change existing datasets. Strict mode is configured on the server.
vocabulary.limits: No duplicates are allowed; between one and one hundred terms. The previous list remains active until this proposal is approved.
vocabulary.approvalHelp: This proposal will replace active suggestions for new values. Review the list before continuing. Datasets and strict validation rules are not changed.

profilesAdmin.heading: Metadata profiles
profilesAdmin.lead: Approved initial values and additional requirements for new deposits.
profilesAdmin.policy: Profiles never remove base requirements or fill in DOI, authorship, privacy or methodological statements. Applying a profile saves a copy of its rules in the dataset. Later changes or deactivation do not change that copy.
profilesAdmin.name: Name
profilesAdmin.initialPolicy: Only empty fields are filled; values already declared by the author are never replaced.
profilesAdmin.failure: The profile could not be managed.
profilesAdmin.approvePolicy: The proposal will become the new active definition. Datasets that used another revision retain their rules.
profilesAdmin.activePolicy: Deactivation prevents new applications; it does not change datasets or delete their metadata.
profilesAdmin.empty: There are no profiles yet. You can continue depositing with the base requirements.
